summary.headline: Last review of the el- tool words: first, same, favorite, other, different, another, last

rules.title: awal before the noun with no el-: awal mara = the first time
bullets: la awal mara = for the first time
nafs el-mara points back to that first time, so kaanat

examples.line: أول مرة أنا جربت أكل عربي - the first time I tried Arabic food
كانت نفس المرة اللي التقيت مع أم خطيبتي لأول مرة - it was the same time I met my fiancée's mom for the first time

rules.title: mfaddal is an adjective after the noun and matches it

examples.line: الأكل المفضل عندي - my favorite food
هذي أكلة خطيبتي المفضلة كمان - this is my fiancée's favorite dish too
هدول أواعي إمي المفضلين - these are my mom's favorite clothes

rules.title: el-taani after an el- noun = the other one
bullets: not taree2 el-taani: both take el-
or taani waa7ad = the second one

examples.line: خلنا نروح على الطريق الثاني عشان هذا بخوّف - let's take the other road, this one is scary

rules.title: another: noun taani / kaman + noun / 8eir + noun / noun mukhtalif
bullets: taani = a different or another one
kaman before the noun = one more of the same
8eir + noun = a different one, never el-

examples.line: أنا بدي عصير تاني - I want another / a different juice
أنا بدي كمان عصير - I want one more juice
عصير مختلف - a juice that is different from the usual
that's the difference between غير and مختلف

rules.title: aa5er + el-noun = the end of it; at the end of the road = (3ala) aa5er el-taree2
bullets: aa5er el-taree2 = the end of the road

examples.line: آخر الطريق - the end of the road
على آخر الطريق في سيارة خربانة - at the end of the road there is a broken car

rules.title: scary = bey5awwef (verb-based adjective); 5aayef = scared
bullets: 5aayef is the person who is scared
bey5awwef = it scares, so it is scary
byebse6 = it makes happy, no preposition after it

examples.line: عشان هذا بخوّف - because this one is scary
الهالوين بيبسط الأولاد - Halloween makes kids happy
